description: This file defines a React functional component named LoginPage that renders a role-selection login UI with modal sign-in functionality. It manages internal state for role selection and entrance animation, and handles user interactions like opening/closing the modal and key events.

methods.name: LoginPage()
methods.description: React functional component for role-based login page with modal sign-in UI.

methods.name: openRole
methods.description: Opens the sign-in modal for the specified role (intern or mentor).

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the sign-in modal and resets role selection.

methods.name: handleGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Placeholder handler for Google Sign-In; intended to preserve role info during auth and redirect accordingly.
